- **Implementation files changed and why:** `packages/ui` adds schema-valid projection-derived shell state, semantic React components and a stylesheet that directly imports canonical tokens. `apps/web` adds the Vite host and a visibly synthetic browser fixture. Root configuration pins React/Vite/Playwright/axe, JSX compilation and browser tests. Unit, E2E and import-boundary tests pin accessibility and the projection firewall. Build evidence records contract ownership, source traceability, screenshots, actual logs and gate state.
- **Contracts added/changed and downstream compatibility:** UI shell contract `0.1.0-test.1`, schema version `1`. `UiShellModelSchema`, `UiSaveStateSchema`, `UiAttentionItemSchema`, `createUiShellModel` and `UiShell` are public. Campaign facts are copied only from accepted `CampaignProjection`; no Prompt 20 contract changes. Exact save/attention presentation fields and responsive matrix are AM-GOV-051 TEST_ONLY proposals. Prompt 22 may consume the shell only after owner acceptance and must preserve the application-only UI boundary.
- **Fixed seed/fixtures:** no random seed is added. Unit projection input reuses the accepted Prompt 19 headless initial fixture. The browser fixture is deterministic, visibly test-only, contains no claimed real data and does not enter campaign persistence or production serializers.
- **Test command + exit code + real output/log path:** `docs/build/logs/21-test.log` records all initial failures, corrections and final outputs. Final focused UI suite: 7/7; Playwright: 9/9; full CI: 20 files / 160 tests; governance: 7/7; web build: exit 0. Failed environment launches, dependency/type/lint corrections, the initial 200% overflow failure and the first governance-fixture failure remain visible.
- **Negative tests and independent fixture ID:** duplicate attention IDs reject; UI-to-domain, UI-to-simulation and web-to-simulation imports reject; five candidate headline indicators are absent in unit and browser output; disabled End month exposes a reason; every visible button has an accessible name; 200% text cannot horizontally overflow; below-1024 viewport shows an explicit unsupported message; act is `Not available`, never inferred.
- **Not tested / reasons:** no approved production browser matrix, real campaign bootstrap, map/document/dossier/decision/resolution surfaces, cloud conflict UX, production fonts/MapLibre glyphs, audio behavior, assistive-technology manual lab, regional/editorial review or novice playtest. VOICE supplies no approved readability target or measured copy caps, so no reading-level figure is invented.
- **Open decisions and scope exclusions:** save/attention presentation envelopes and the 1920/1440/1280/1024 responsive matrix require review. The accepted projection has no act field. The five candidate indicators remain suspended. `AUDIO.md` is absent, but no audio behavior is introduced. Noto Sans/Charis SIL are not self-hosted. Intuitiveness and comprehension are verified by proxy only.
- **Evidence artifacts / verifier and owner sign-off:** `docs/build/UI_SHELL_CONTRACT.md`, AM-GOV-050/051, `docs/build/ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE.md`, `docs/build/DOMAIN_CONTRACT_INVENTORY.md`, `docs/build/BUILD_STATE.json`, the five PNG captures plus README, this handoff and `docs/build/logs/21-test.log`. No Prompt 21 owner sign-off or ACCEPTED state is claimed.
- **Next prerequisite and revalidation requirements:** an independent reviewer should run the commands below from a frozen install, inspect all five captures at actual size, repeat the keyboard/200% paths, review the TEST_ONLY presentation shapes and confirm the canonical token hash. The repository owner may then record an accepting commit under AM-GOV-001. PB2-22 must not begin before PB2-21 is ACCEPTED.

## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm run test:ui
corepack pnpm run test:boundaries
corepack pnpm run test:e2e
corepack pnpm --filter @african-mandate/web run build
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 docs/tokens.css).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
git diff --check
git diff --stat
```

Pass means the focused suite reports 7/7; all three forbidden imports reject; Playwright reports 9/9 with no axe violations, unnamed buttons, text overflow or phantom headline indicators; all five screenshots exist; build exits 0; full CI reports 20 files / 160 tests; governance reports 7/7; the canonical token hash is `f534d03bbf1b60e65781972d5e358076b8b572005672bb5b1c61727a9718d4e9`; exact changed paths match this handoff; and Prompt 21 remains `READY_FOR_REVIEW` with no approval metadata.

## Diff summary

Prompt 21 introduces the first React/Vite presentation slice without crossing the simulation boundary: a canonical-token shell, projection-derived status strip, semantic navigation, attention queue, explicit ready/loading/error/partial states and hard TEST_ONLY markings. It adds unit/browser/accessibility/viewport evidence, preserves all unavailable production decisions as blockers, reconciles the owner-reviewed Prompt 20 acceptance, and does not add map, document, decision or production scenario functionality.
